incidents.description: Tao bang: demo-app + ingestion + OpenSearch that (docker compose), goi lap lai /simulate-error?rate=0.8&fault_type=error nhieu lan. Chay `python -m clustering.src.main` (CLUSTER_STORE_BACKEND=opensearch, mac dinh) ghi 1 ClusterRecord thuc vao index `clusters`: 13 log ERROR cung signature, score=13.0 (chua co lich su baseline truoc do nen rơi vao nhanh fallback score=count trong anomaly_score.compute_anomaly_score), vuot ANOMALY_THRESHOLD=2.0 -> status=alerted. Xac nhan qua: curl http://localhost:9200/clusters/_search?pretty.
